type: Text; enum (experimental / control / single arm / dose cohort)
definition: Role of the arm only. One of the enum values. The arm's name is already known from the arm list.
Regimen as the abstract names it: a named combination (D-VRd, pola-R-CHP, 7+3) or, for a single-drug arm, the drug's name (pirtobrutinib). Not empty for monotherapy.
Drugs in the regimen as the abstract names them, joined with ' + '. Do not expand an abbreviation (Pola-BR) unless the abstract expands it.

type: Number + unit (mg, mg/kg, mg/m², cells for CAR-T)

definition: Fill only when the abstract says the route (IV, intravenous, infusion, SC, subcutaneous, oral, orally). A dose or schedule alone (200 mg QD) is not a route.
e.g. Q3W; days 1-21 of a 28-day cycle
Priming doses before the full dose, as reported

type: Enum: fixed duration / continuous (treat to progression)
definition: fixed duration: the abstract states a cap (N cycles, N months, a single infusion). continuous: it says until progression or unacceptable toxicity. 'Still on treatment at cutoff' is neither: leave empty.

type: Enum: induction / consolidation / maintenance / salvage / bridging / conditioning
definition: Every phase the arm's protocol covers, in order, joined with ' + ' (induction + consolidation).
allowed_values: induction / consolidation / maintenance / salvage / bridging / conditioning

definition: Molecular target, e.g. BCMA, CD20xCD3, BTK, BCL2

type: Enum: antibody / bispecific / ADC / small molecule / CAR-T / other cell therapy / chemotherapy / other
definition: Fill only from the abstract's own words (antibody, bispecific, ADC, CAR-T, small molecule). 'Inhibitor' alone does not state a modality: leave empty.
allowed_values: antibody / bispecific / ADC / small molecule / CAR-T / other cell therapy / chemotherapy / other

definition: e.g. covalent BTK inhibitor, anti-CD38 antibody

applies_to: CAR-T and other cell therapy arms
definition: e.g. cilta-cel, axi-cel

applies_to: CAR-T and other cell therapy arms
definition: e.g. Flu/Cy, bendamustine

applies_to: CAR-T and other cell therapy arms
definition: Therapy given between apheresis and infusion, e.g. R-GemOx, radiotherapy

type: Enum + version: IMWG 2016 / iwCLL 2018 / Lugano 2014 / ELN 2022 / IWG 2023 / IWWM-11 / other
definition: Name of the criteria the response endpoints were assessed by. Version only if the abstract states it; 'IMWG' with no year stays 'IMWG'. Criteria cited for one definition only (e.g. MRD-negative CR) do not count.
Who assessed response or progression (independent review committee or investigator)

Disease and setting as the abstract states them for the enrolled population (e.g. relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma). A subgroup being analysed is not the subtype. No code: NCIt codes are mapped in code afterwards.
Median number of prior lines of therapy in the population, e.g. median 4
Range of prior lines of therapy, e.g. 1-11

type: Enum: transplant-eligible / transplant-ineligible / fit / unfit (as reported)
definition: Only the abstract's own wording. 'Eligible for intensive chemotherapy' is 'fit', not transplant-eligible.
Patients enrolled or randomized to THIS arm. If only a trial total is given, leave the arm empty and fill 'Patients enrolled (trial total)'.
Patients who received treatment in THIS arm. A sum of stated strata counts is allowed and is marked derived.
Patients evaluable for the primary endpoint in THIS arm. A trial total goes nowhere on the arm.
Percent of the control arm that crossed over

Observed baseline markers of the enrolled population with their shares (del(17p) 15%). Asked once for the trial. If the abstract gives shares per arm, the per-arm shares go to extra values. Names of subgroups used in an outcome analysis are not biomarkers. The marker REQUIRED to enrol comes from the registry.
Median progression-free survival. Never EFS, RFS, DFS or TTP: those have their own fields.
Median follow-up the abstract ties to the PFS analysis. A follow-up stated for the study as a whole goes in 'Median follow-up (overall)'.
Hazard ratio for PFS, experimental vs control. Written on the experimental arm only. The quote must name PFS or progression-free.
Median overall survival
Hazard ratio for OS, experimental vs control. Written on the experimental arm only.
Event-free survival; record the event definition if given
Relapse-free survival, measured from CR
Disease-free survival
Leukemia-free survival
Share of responders still in response at the stated time
Time to next treatment
Time to progression on the next line of therapy, or death
GRFS: survival free of grade III-IV acute GVHD, chronic GVHD needing systemic therapy, relapse and death (Holtan, Blood 2015)
Death without prior relapse or progression
Overall response rate under the stated criteria. Never fill it from a CR rate, a CR/CRi rate or an MRD rate.
Complete response alone, under the stated criteria. Myeloma 'CR or better' goes in >=CR rate. AML CR/CRi and CR/CRh have their own fields.
Myeloma: ORR plus minimal response (>=MR, IMWG). Waldenström has no formal CBR (IWWM); treat a reported CBR as trial-defined
Progression or death within 24 months of starting first-line chemoimmunotherapy (Casulo, JCO 2015); some papers anchor on diagnosis, so record the anchor
Myeloma VGPR (IMWG 2016): M-protein detectable by immunofixation but not electrophoresis, or >=90% serum M-protein reduction and urine M-protein <100 mg/24 h. AL: VGPR is dFLC <40 mg/L
Myeloma CR or better (IMWG 2016): CR plus sCR. CR is negative serum and urine immunofixation, no soft-tissue plasmacytomas and <5% plasma cells in marrow
Stringent CR (IMWG). A rate of MRD negativity among sCR patients is an MRD value, not an sCR rate.
CR plus CRh only. CR/CRi goes in Composite CR.
No ELN 2022 standard; trials define it (CR + CRi, or CR + CRh + CRi). Record which components were counted
Morphologic leukemia-free state (ELN 2022): marrow blasts <5%, no Auer rods, no circulating blasts, no extramedullary disease; no count recovery required
Share of the arm (or of MRD-evaluable patients in the arm) that is MRD-negative. detail = assay and threshold. A subgroup's rate goes to extra values.
Myeloma (IMWG 2016): MRD negativity in marrow confirmed at least 1 year apart
CR with MRD below the stated threshold; ELN 2022 adds MRD-negative suffixes (CR-MRDneg, CRh-MRDneg)
Share who went on to allo-HCT only. A rate that pools transplant with CAR-T or other therapy does not count.
iwCLL 2018: <1 CLL cell per 10,000 leukocytes (<10^-4) in blood or marrow
Share with RBC transfusion independence in the analysis this abstract reports. detail = duration (>=8 weeks). Earlier-analysis figures quoted as background are ignored.
IWG 2006 (MDS): Hb rise >=1.5 g/dL, or >=4 fewer RBC units per 8 weeks, lasting >=8 weeks; IWG 2018 revises it for lower-risk MDS
Major molecular response (ELN 2020): BCR::ABL1 <=0.1% on the International Scale
>=35% reduction in spleen volume from baseline by MRI or CT; timepoint is trial-specific (usually week 24)
>=50% reduction in total symptom score (MFSAF) from baseline; timepoint is trial-specific (usually week 24)
Waldenström (IWWM-6 / IWWM-11): PR or better, i.e. >=50% IgM reduction; distinct from ORR, which includes MR (>=25%)
ISA 2012 consensus: negative serum and urine immunofixation and normal FLC ratio
Number of patients with a DLT in THIS arm or dose level. detail = number DLT-evaluable.
Highest dose with a DLT rate below the target (typically <33%, e.g. <=1 of 6)
Dose chosen for phase 2 from safety, PK/PD and activity; can be below the MTD
Share of the arm with any grade >=3 adverse event, as an overall rate. Do not sum individual event rates and do not use a single event's rate.
Share of the arm with CRS of any grade. 'All patients' is 100 and 'none' is 0 (marked derived). detail = grading system if stated.

ASTCT 2019: grade 3 = hypotension needing one vasopressor (with or without vasopressin) and/or high-flow nasal cannula, facemask, non-rebreather or Venturi mask; grade 4 = multiple vasopressors and/or positive pressure (CPAP, BiPAP, intubation)
Share of the arm with ICANS of any grade, as a percentage. A bare event count with no denominator is not a rate: put it in extra values.
ASTCT 2019 grade 3-4 (e.g. ICE 0-2, seizure, or cerebral edema)
Deaths from any cause within 30 days of starting treatment
Deaths from any cause within 60 days of starting treatment
Share of the arm with any immune-related adverse event.
Share of the arm with an infusion-related reaction of any grade.
Name of the trial as the abstract states it, e.g. CARTITUDE-4. Empty for drug or disease abbreviations and for bare protocol codes. Used only when the registry has no acronym.
Which analysis this abstract reports, in the abstract's own words.
allowed_values: interim / primary / final / updated or long-term follow-up / post hoc

definition: Median follow-up stated for the study or the reported analysis as a whole, when it is not tied to one endpoint.
Total enrolled or randomized across all arms.
